title: NestJS Project Initialization
description: Scaffold a new NestJS project. The application must compile and run successfully, returning a 'Hello World!' response at the root endpoint.

criterias.text: NestJS project is scaffolded using nest CLI
criterias.hint:
Use the **NestJS CLI** to scaffold a new project with all default configurations.

**Step 1:** Install the CLI and create a project:
```bash
npx @nestjs/cli new project-name
```

**Step 2:** Choose your package manager when prompted (npm/yarn/pnpm).

**Expected directory structure:**
```mermaid
treeView-beta
  "project-name/"
    "src/"
      "app.controller.ts"
      "app.module.ts"
      "app.service.ts"
      "main.ts"
    "test/"
    "package.json"
    "nest-cli.json"
    "tsconfig.json"
```

**Note:** The CLI automatically generates the project structure with a working controller, service, and module. Read more at [NestJS First Steps](https://docs.nestjs.com/first-steps).
criterias.promptText:
Grading rubric (max 3):

- Criterion (3 points): NestJS project is scaffolded using nest CLI

Scoring rule: award full points only when the criterion is fully met with concrete evidence in the repository. Award 0 if not found or incomplete.

criterias.text: The application compiles and starts without errors
criterias.hint:
Verify the application compiles and runs correctly in development mode.

**Step 1:** Install dependencies:
```bash
npm install
```

**Step 2:** Start the application in watch mode:
```bash
nest start --watch
```

**Step 3:** Verify no errors in the console. Expected output:
```text
[Nest] LOG [NestFactory] Starting Nest application...
[Nest] LOG [NestApplication] Nest application successfully started
```

**Note:** If you encounter compilation errors, check that your Node.js version is >= 18. Use `node -v` to verify. Read more at [NestJS CLI](https://docs.nestjs.com/cli/overview).
